integrity: Proof and full standalone standard-library verification source are embedded with byte counts and SHA-256 in the containing record. Finite direct checks do not replace the universal reduction.
scientific_limitations: Classification restricted to ordinary dominating vertex sets of KG(n,2), n>=4. A proved six-edge reduction plus an exhaustive finite isomorphism-class census supply the critical structural step; independent mathematical audit and exhaustive priority verification are not claimed.
title: Inclusion-minimal domination in two-subset Kneser graphs
